content:
maria: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

what I did: landed prefetch hotpatch on kernel/prefetch-hotfix, ran microbatch bench against canary nodes. saw p90 improvement but a persistent tail for long sequences.
blockers: KV eviction still flakes on canary under microburst; need logs from node-12 and jemalloc dumps.
today: collect dumps, add defensive null-check in kv lookup PR, and coordinate staging repro with @ben.

chris: nice work. can you paste the bench cmd + raw output you used?

maria: sure — ran the bench script locally and on canary:
```
# bench command
./bench/microbatch.sh --model t5-small --iters 200 --seq-len 256

# sample output (canary)
P50: 3.2ms  P90: 12.8ms  P99: 54.3ms
after prefetch patch (same rig):
P50: 3.1ms  P90: 4.4ms  P99: 52.9ms
```

anita: that P99 is worrying — could be GC or a jemalloc fallback. can you capture /proc/<pid>/smaps and jemalloc stats when it happens? also, are the spikes correlated with larger seq_len runs (>=512)?

maria: good call. I reproduced a P99 spike with seq_len=1024. grabbing jemalloc dumps now, will attach when done (~30m).

ben: on the KV eviction angle — I've seen a similar symptom when prefetch windows overlap with shard rebalances. I'll spin up a staging repro with controlled rebalances and run your bench. @maria do you want me to coordinate the repro and collect kernel traces?

maria: yes please, that'd be great. I'll open an issue with the log pointers and link the kv PR.

infra-bot: deploy (redwood-runtime/canary) started by @ben — image: runtime-canary:0.53.2, nodes: eu-west-3 (3 instances)

chris: FYI I pushed a small fix for batch-slot assignment in scheduler (branch scheduler/slot-fix). mainline tests passed locally, rolling canary in eu-west in 5m. should help with microburst ordering.

anita: quick note / blocker for me: test coverage is missing for the prefetch eviction path. I'll add an integration test that simulates eviction while prefetch reads are in-flight — aiming to ship tomorrow AM.

ben: no blockers beyond the staging repro; will add a microbenchmark for seq_len>512 to bench-suite and tag @maria when ready.

maria: thanks — when you add the seq>512 bench, can you include an env var to toggle jemalloc profiling? that'll make dumps easier to correlate.

ben: yep, adding --jemalloc-profile flag to bench harness.

chris: small housekeeping — PR #4891 (scheduler slot fix) needs a quick review from @anita if you get a chance. tiny change.

anita: will review after lunch, thanks for the ping. :+1:

maria: that's it from me for today — collecting traces and opening the kv issue now. ping if you want to jump on a repro call later. :rocket:

chris: thanks all. no blockers on my side.

anita: thanks — will follow up with test PR tomorrow.

ben: starting repro run now, will update the issue with traces and perf logs.

infra-bot: deploy (redwood-runtime/eu-west) finished — canary 0.53.2 rolled to 2/3 nodes, health checks OK.

maria: awesome, thanks everyone :tada:
